summary: George Russell's power-unit penalty relegates Mercedes' championship contender to the back of the grid, handing rivals a rare opening to capitalize on a compromised challenger in Singapore's unforgiving night race. Valtteri Bottas arrives at the Marina Bay circuit after an unconventional journey by bicycle from Malaysia, testing both his physical condition and mental focus ahead of the season's final sprint weekend. A strong result here could prove decisive for title protagonists, as this marks the sixth and final sprint event of the season, offering compressed opportunities to harvest crucial points before the championship's closing stretch.
